title: McMoneagle's Pentagon remote viewing of a UFO above a nuclear missile

tellings.quote: the story is that he basically saw a UFO hovering over a nuclear missile

plain: Working for the Pentagon, a remote viewer named Joe McMoneagle (someone said to see distant places by mind alone) saw a UFO hovering over a nuclear missile. The researcher Robert Hastings, who studies UFO reports at nuclear bases, tells Michels the story as it came from McMoneagle. If true, it would tie the military's psychic spying to its concern about UFOs at nuclear weapons.
